summary.text: Tiffany Prater is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mark Chapman.
An educator, she described herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a teacher and professor.

paragraphs.text: Tiffany Prater earned a high school diploma from Eisenhower High School, a bachelor's degree from Cameron University in 2016 and a graduate degree from Southern New Hampshire University in 2021.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Prater listed affordable healthcare, quality education for all Oklahoma students, and rural roads and bridges among her key campaign messages.
She named the Oklahoma Democratic Party Veterans Federation, Sally's List and Planned Parenthood as endorsers.
